title: motilal_wcs_16_2006_11.txt
rule: Blue Chip Buy Signal #2: Buy Blue Chip stock when Dividend Yield > 3.0%
entry: Buy blue-chip quality stock whenever its trailing Dividend Yield crosses above 3.0%.
exit: Hold long-term for mean reversion as price appreciates and yield normalizes.
conditions: Applied to blue-chip stocks where standard average yield is around 1.5%. A yield >3% signifies deep correction or step-up dividend.
data_needed: Stock price and declared annual dividend data.

title: motilal_wcs_16_2006_11.txt
rule: Potential Blue Chip 5-Factor Fundamental Screen
entry: Select and buy stocks meeting all 5 quantitative filters: (1) Uninterrupted annual dividends for last 5 years, (2) EPS increase in at least 3 of last 5 years, (3) Dividend increase in at least 2 of last 5 years, (4) Minimum RoE >= 15% in ALL 5 individual years, (5) 5-year PAT CAGR >= 10%.
exit: Hold multi-year as potential blue chip transitions into recognized blue chip status.
conditions: Market Cap <= Rs 10,000 Crore (INR 100b) classified as Potential Blue Chip; Market Cap > Rs 10,000 Crore classified as Recognized Blue Chip.
data_needed: 5-year annual historical EPS, Dividend per share, RoE, PAT growth rate, and Market Cap.

title: motilal_wcs_16_2006_11.txt
rule: Blue Chip Extreme Overvaluation Sell Signal (P/E ~40x & Dividend Yield <= 0.3%)
entry: Re-enter position only after stock valuation corrects back below its 10-year median P/E.
exit: Sell entire position in blue-chip stock when P/E expands drastically (e.g. 4x expansion up to ~40x P/E) and Dividend Yield drops to extreme lows of <= 0.3%.
conditions: Applies to blue-chip stocks experiencing euphoric multi-fold price expansion divorced from dividend yield dynamics.
data_needed: Historical P/E trajectory and Dividend Yield historical levels.

title: motilal_wcs_17_2007_12.txt
rule: 8-Year Sector-Relative RoE Persistence Screen (Economic Moat Filter)
entry: Pichle 8 saalon me se kam se kam 6 saal tak jis company ka Annual RoE uske Sector Average RoE se adhik ho, unka portfolio bana kar buy karo
exit: 10 saal tak hold karo ya jab tak company ka RoE sector average se niche na chala jaye
conditions: Company RoE > Sector Average RoE in >= 6 out of past 8 financial years
data_needed: fundamentals (Company Annual RoE and Sector Average RoE for past 8 years)

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: Emerging Value Creator 6-Step Quantitative Screening Model: Company age < 25 years + First time RoE > 15% + PAT >= Rs 10 Crore + Non-Cyclical business + Trailing P/E <= 20x
entry: Screen on annual financial results release when company age < 25 years, RoE crosses 15% for the first time in past 10-15 years history, PAT >= Rs 100 million (Rs 10 Cr), and Trailing P/E <= 20x.
exit: Hold for 5 years or exit if RoE drops consistently below 15%.
conditions: Company incorporation age < 25 years, 1-year RoE > 15% (first time ever), PAT >= Rs 10 Cr, exclude cyclical sectors (metals, sugar, real estate, commodities), Trailing P/E <= 20x.
data_needed: Annual balance sheet, annual PAT, RoE history (10-15 years), incorporation date, daily OHLCV for P/E calculation.

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: Optimized Emerging Value Creator Strategy (with 3 Performance Amplifiers): Emerging Screen + High Industry Profit Pool + B2C Consumer Advantage + Top 3 Market Leadership
entry: Apply base Emerging Value Creator filter (Age < 25 yrs, First time RoE > 15%, PAT >= Rs 10 Cr, P/E <= 20x), and select only those meeting all 3 amplifiers: (1) Industry aggregate PAT is in top 50% of corporate sectors, (2) B2C business model (Consumer Advantage), (3) Top 3 market share rank in its category.
exit: Hold for 5 years.
conditions: Base Emerging Screen criteria + High Profit Pool sector + B2C model + Top 3 market share rank.
data_needed: Annual financial fundamentals, market share data, sector PAT data, P/E ratio.

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: Enduring Value Creator 5-Step Fundamental Screen: 10 Consecutive Years RoE > 15% + 3-Year PAT CAGR > 15% + 5-Year RoE Delta > 0 + Trailing P/E <= 30x
entry: Buy stocks that satisfy: (1) RoE > 15% for each of the last 10 consecutive years, (2) 3-year PAT CAGR > 15%, (3) RoE in year T > RoE in year T-5 (5-year RoE Delta > 0), (4) Trailing P/E <= 30x.
exit: Rebalance annually or exit if RoE drops below 15%.
conditions: 10-year continuous RoE >= 15%, 3-year PAT CAGR >= 15%, RoE_t > RoE_{t-5}, trailing P/E <= 30x.
data_needed: 10-year historical annual financial statements (PAT, Networth/RoE), daily price data for P/E.

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: Market Outperformance Wealth Creation Filter: 5-Year Stock Price CAGR > 5-Year Benchmark (Sensex) Price CAGR
entry: When screening wealth-creating portfolios or stock universes, strictly eliminate any stock where 5-year Price CAGR <= 5-year Sensex Price CAGR, regardless of absolute market cap generated.
exit: Screening filter only.
conditions: Stock Price 5-Year CAGR > Sensex 5-Year CAGR.
data_needed: 5-year historical stock price CAGR and Sensex 5-year price CAGR.

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: Macro Equity Bottoming & Favorable Allocation Screen: Corporate Profit / GDP <= 4.5% AND Market Cap / GDP <= 61%
entry: Go aggressive long on index / broad market equities when Corporate Profit to GDP ratio falls to/below 4.5% AND Market Cap to GDP ratio is <= 61%.
exit: Reduce equity allocation when Market Cap to GDP ratio exceeds 100%.
conditions: Corporate Profit / GDP <= 4.5% and Total Market Cap / GDP <= 61%.
data_needed: Annual GDP data, aggregate corporate profits, total market capitalization.

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: Sector Overvaluation Avoidance Filter: Sector P/E > 2x Market Average P/E par long positions avoid karo; capital ko reasonable valuation (P/E ~ market average) + high PAT CAGR + high RoE wale sectors me rotate karo.
entry: Jab target sector P/E market average P/E ke close (e.g. 19x vs 15x) ho aur sector PAT CAGR + RoE overall market se zyada ho tab allocation karo.
exit: Jab sector P/E overall market average P/E se 2x se adhik ho jaaye ya earnings growth stagnant ho jaaye.
conditions: Avoid sectors with P/E > 2x Market average (e.g., Consumer at 33x vs Market 15x). Allocate to sectors like Tech (P/E 19x with high PAT CAGR and RoE).
data_needed: Sector P/E, Market Average P/E, Sector PAT CAGR, Sector Average RoE

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: PSU Sectoral Exclusion Filter: Screening me Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) ko filter out karo, visheshkar Utilities, Metals & Mining, aur Capital Goods sectors me.
entry: Private sector peer stocks me entry lo jahan 5-year Sales CAGR > 20%, PAT CAGR > 20%, aur RoE > 20% ho.
exit: number nahi diya
conditions: PSU overall PAT CAGR (7% vs Private 21%) aur RoE trajectory (20% down to 14%) severely lag private companies. Limit PSU exposure strictly or avoid completely outside Oil & Gas / Financials.
data_needed: Company Ownership (PSU vs Private), Sector, Financial Performance Metrics

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: Base Market Cap < INR 5 Billion (Rs 500 Crore) Return Multiplier Setup: Multi-year outperformance ke liye base market cap < INR 5 Billion (< Rs 500 Cr) wali growth companies ko select karo.
entry: Base year Market Cap < INR 5 Billion (Rs 500 Crore) ho aur company high sales & earnings growth report kar rahi ho.
exit: 5 years holding period ya jab target market cap re-rating achieved ho jaaye.
conditions: Base market cap INR 1-5b delivered 65% Price CAGR compared to >INR 20b delivering only 16-17% Price CAGR.
data_needed: Base Market Cap, PAT CAGR, Price CAGR

title: motilal_wcs_18_2008_13.txt
rule: High RoE (>30%) Earnings Longevity Rule: High earnings power (RoE > 30%) wali companies me long position lo, chahe PAT growth moderate (14-15%) hi kyon na ho.
entry: Base year RoE > 30% wale stocks kharido.
exit: Jab trailing RoE < 20% gir jaye.
conditions: RoE > 30% companies delivered 21-24% Price CAGR despite modest PAT CAGR (14-15%), whereas RoE < 15% companies delivered lower stock returns (17% Price CAGR) despite high PAT CAGR (36%).
data_needed: RoE, Historical PAT CAGR, Stock Price CAGR

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: 100x Multi-bagger SQGLP Stock Screening Rule: Select stocks with Market Cap <= Rs 3,000 Crore (INR 30 Billion / USD 0.5 Billion), Trailing P/E <= 25x, operating in Value Migration or Niche business model with high RoE.
entry: Buy stocks matching all criteria: Market Cap <= Rs 3,000 Crore, Trailing 12-month P/E <= 25x, operating in Value Migration (Global/Local) or Niche industry, low analyst coverage, and low institutional holding.
exit: Hold for multi-year compound expansion until earnings growth reverts to GDP growth mean or Competitive Advantage Period (CAP) ends.
conditions: Market Cap <= Rs 30 Billion; Trailing P/E <= 25x; Industry theme = Value Migration or Niche; High RoE (> cost of capital).
data_needed: Market Cap, Trailing P/E, Business description/sector classification, Institutional Holding %, RoE.

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: Quality-Growth Matrix Filtering Rule: Avoid Quality Traps (Low Growth) and Growth Traps (Low RoE/Cyclical), and select only High-Quality + High-Growth small-cap stocks.
entry: Filter out stocks with RoE < Cost of Capital (Low Quality) and stocks with PAT CAGR < Nominal GDP Growth (Low Growth). Buy stocks with RoE > 20% AND Sales/PAT CAGR > 20% with Market Cap < Rs 3,000 Crore.
exit: Exit when PAT growth drops below GDP growth or RoE falls below Cost of Capital.
conditions: RoE > 20%, Sales/PAT CAGR > 20%, Market Cap < Rs 30 Billion.
data_needed: RoE, 3-5 Year Sales CAGR, 3-5 Year PAT CAGR, Market Cap.

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: Market Cap to GDP Parity 2-Year Target Macro Rule: Buy broader market / index when Market Cap to GDP is <= 77% for a 2-year 50% market cap upside target.
entry: Initiate long position on Market Index when India Market Cap to GDP ratio drops to or below 77% (near 10-year average of 73%).
exit: Exit / book profit when Market Cap to GDP approaches 100% (parity with GDP) or after 2 years target period.
conditions: Market Cap to GDP ratio <= 77% (Historical 10-yr LPA = 73%, Peak = 103%). Target = 50% market upside over 2 years.
data_needed: Total Indian Stock Market Cap, India Annual Nominal GDP.

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: Sensex Earnings Yield to Bond Yield Interest Rate Trigger Rule: Track Sensex Earnings Yield / 10-Year G-Sec Yield vs historical LPA of 0.85x to signal market upside momentum.
entry: When Sensex Earnings Yield / 10-Year G-Sec Yield ratio is below 0.85x (e.g. 0.76x), expect market upside to accelerate once 10-Year G-Sec yield drops / interest rates fall.
exit: number nahi diya
conditions: Sensex 1-year forward P/E Earnings Yield (1/PE) divided by 10-Year G-Sec Yield < 0.85x.
data_needed: Sensex 1-year forward P/E, 10-Year Indian G-Sec Yield.

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: PSU Long Selection Filter: Only buy PSU stocks that match private sector benchmarks with 5-year Sales CAGR >= 17%, 5-year PAT CAGR >= 24%, and RoE >= 18%.
entry: Buy PSU stocks only when 5-year Sales CAGR >= 17%, 5-year PAT CAGR >= 24%, and RoE >= 18%.
exit: Exit PSU holding if 5-year PAT CAGR falls below 20% or RoE drops below 15%.
conditions: Filters out value-trap PSUs while allowing top performers in Oil & Gas and Financials.
data_needed: fundamentals (5-year Sales, PAT CAGR, and annual RoE)

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: Small-Cap Price Acceleration Tier Filter: Prefer stocks with base Market Cap between INR 1 Billion to INR 25 Billion (Rs 100 Cr to Rs 2,500 Cr) for highest Price CAGR (51% avg).
entry: Filter universe for base Market Cap between Rs 100 Cr and Rs 2,500 Cr (INR 1-25 Billion) showing positive earnings acceleration.
exit: Trim/rebalance position when company transitions into large-cap (>Rs 10,000 Cr) or P/E re-rating plateaus.
conditions: Small-caps offer highest P/E re-rating upside due to initial market under-coverage.
data_needed: market cap and P/E historical data

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: PAT CAGR Outperformance Target Filter: Filter for stocks with projected/historical 5-year PAT CAGR > 30% to capture 42%+ Price CAGR.
entry: Buy stocks demonstrating 5-year PAT CAGR > 30%.
exit: Exit when 5-year PAT CAGR slows down below 20%.
conditions: Avoid PAT CAGR < 10% stocks as Price CAGR drops to 25% with P/E de-rating risk.
data_needed: 5-year historical and projected PAT figures

title: motilal_wcs_19_2009_14.txt
rule: Structural Wealth Destroying Sector Avoidance Filter: Completely avoid long positions in Utilities, Capital Goods, Real Estate, Metals/Mining, and Telecom sectors during economic/policy slowdowns.
entry: Filter out and avoid buying stocks in Utilities, Capital Goods, Real Estate/Construction, Metals/Mining, and Telecom sectors.
exit: Exit immediately if a portfolio stock enters structural policy/cyclical headwinds in these sectors.
conditions: These 5 sectors caused over 55% of aggregate market wealth destruction.
data_needed: sector classification

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: MQGLP Mid-to-Mega 6-Step Stock Selection Filter: Buy stocks ranked 101-300 in market cap with base RoE >= 20%, top 3 industry revenue leadership (or Value Migration beneficiary), preceding 2-year PAT CAGR >= 20%, secular model, and trailing P/E <= 25x; hold for 5 years targeting top 100 rank.
entry: Buy stocks ranked 101-300 by market cap meeting all 5 screening criteria: (1) Base RoE >= 20%, (2) Industry Revenue Rank #1, #2, or #3 OR Value Migration beneficiary, (3) Preceding 2-year PAT CAGR >= 20%, (4) Secular business model, (5) Trailing P/E <= 25x.
exit: Hold for 5 years or until market cap rank enters Top 100 / fundamentals degrade.
stop: Exit if annual RoE falls below 15% or trailing 2-year PAT CAGR drops below 0%.
conditions: Filters out cyclicals; requires top 3 market share by revenue or structural Value Migration theme.
data_needed: Market cap rankings (ranks 1-300), annual RoE, 2-year historical PAT CAGR, sector revenue rankings, trailing P/E ratio, 5-year OHLC data

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Quality Trap Avoidance Filter: Avoid buying or exit long positions in high RoE companies (> 20%) if trailing 3-to-5 year PAT CAGR is below 10% or below benchmark GDP/Sensex CAGR.
entry: Do not enter long positions if stock has RoE >= 20% but 3-year PAT CAGR < 10%. Exit existing long positions if trailing 3-year PAT CAGR falls below 10%.
exit: Exit immediately upon trailing 3-year PAT CAGR falling below 10%.
conditions: Applies to mature high-RoE companies facing growth saturation (e.g. Hero MotoCorp, Wipro, ACC).
data_needed: Annual RoE, 3-year and 5-year PAT CAGR, benchmark Sensex earnings growth data

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Mega-to-Mid Dropout Avoidance Rule: Avoid or sell Top 100 Market Cap stocks that are non-leaders (ranked 4th or lower in sector revenue) or belong to cyclical sectors entering earnings deceleration.
entry: Avoid entering or holding Top 100 market cap stocks if their industry revenue rank drops outside top 3 OR if cyclical sector PAT decelerates for 2 consecutive quarters.
exit: Sell stock immediately when industry revenue rank falls below 3rd position or cyclical earnings turn negative.
conditions: 75% of Mega-to-Mid dropouts are non-leaders; 35% of dropouts are caused by cyclical downturns.
data_needed: Top 100 Market cap rankings, quarterly sector revenue ranks, 2-quarter PAT growth trends

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Corporate Profit to GDP Macro Bottom Equities Accumulation Rule: Go aggressive long / overweight equities when Corporate Profit to GDP ratio drops below 4.0% and India Market Cap to GDP is below 76%.
entry: Increase broad equity allocation / go long broad index when India Corporate Profit to GDP ratio < 4.0% (historical average 5.0%) and Market Cap to GDP ratio < 76%.
exit: Reduce equity allocation when Corporate Profit to GDP ratio expands above 6.5%.
conditions: Corporate Profit / GDP < 4.0%, Market Cap / GDP < 76%.
data_needed: India Total Listed Corporate Net Profits, India Nominal GDP, Total India Market Capitalization

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Rising Profitability & De-leveraging Triad Screen: Buy companies showing simultaneous expansion of PAT Margin, stable Asset Turnover, and declining Debt-to-Equity with RoCE > G-Sec Yield
entry: Buy stocks meeting all 4 financial acceleration criteria upon annual report publication
exit: Exit when PAT margin declines for 2 consecutive years or gearing increases significantly to fund unprofitable expansion
stop: Trailing stop loss of 20% from peak or fundamental failure
conditions: PAT Margin (PAT/Sales) rising over 3-5 consecutive years AND Asset Turnover (Sales/Total Assets) stable or rising AND Gearing/Debt-to-Equity falling AND RoCE > prevailing G-Sec coupon rate
data_needed: annual financial statements (PAT, Sales, Total Assets, Total Debt, Equity, RoCE, G-Sec yield)

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Terms of Trade Working Capital Filter: Buy stocks with favorable Terms of Trade (Debtors to Creditors Ratio < 1.0)
entry: Filter and select stocks where Debtors / Creditors < 100% (Debtors < Creditors)
exit: Exit or reject when Debtors / Creditors ratio exceeds 1.5x (unfavorable working capital pressure)
conditions: Debtors / Creditors < 1.0 (indicates strong bargaining power with suppliers and customers)
data_needed: balance sheet data (Trade Receivables / Debtors, Trade Payables / Creditors)

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Commodity Cycle Squeeze Exit Rule: Sell commodity/cyclical stocks during the supply Squeeze phase when capacity utilization hits 100% and profits spike exponentially
entry: Enter commodity stocks during Recovery phase (moderate capacity utilization, rising product prices)
exit: Sell completely during Squeeze phase (near 100% capacity utilization, supply shortage, exponential profit surge) before fresh capacity creates Glut
stop: Trailing stop loss or exit on sign of aggressive industry-wide expansion announcements
conditions: Industry capacity utilization > 95% AND quarterly profit YoY growth > 100% in cyclical/commodity sectors (Metals, Mining, Chemicals)
data_needed: industry capacity utilization metrics, commodity spot prices, quarterly earnings data

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Winner Category Sector Selection Filter: Select sectors expected to grow revenue at >= 1.5x nominal GDP growth rate
entry: Overweight sectors whose projected annual revenue growth rate >= 1.5 * Projected Nominal GDP Growth
exit: Underweight or exit sector when sector growth slows below 1.0x nominal GDP growth
conditions: Sector Revenue Growth Rate >= 1.5 * Nominal GDP Growth Rate
data_needed: macroeconomic GDP projections, industry aggregate revenue growth estimates

title: motilal_wcs_20_2010_15.txt
rule: Global Commodity & PSU Wealth Destroyer Avoidance Filter: Exclude PSU commodity/metals/mining stocks from long-term portfolio allocation
entry: N/A (Filter out)
exit: Immediate liquidation if stock is a PSU operating in global commodities/cyclicals
conditions: Filter out companies with Government / PSU ownership > 50% AND operating in cyclical/global commodity sectors (Metals, Mining, Oil & Gas, Capital Goods)
data_needed: ownership shareholding pattern, sector classification

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: Modified Kelly Formula Position Sizing: Long-term stock portfolio me position size fraction f = (Up - Dq) / U ke dwara tay karo, jahan U = Expected Upside %, p = Upside Probability, D = Expected Downside %, q = Downside Probability
entry: Jab Edge (Up - Dq) > 0 ho aur payoff asymmetric (High Upside vs Low Downside) ho
exit: Expected upside target achieve hone par ya fundamental downside thesis hit hone par
stop: D (Max estimated downside %) par stop-loss consider karo
conditions: Kelly fraction tabhi apply karo jab analytical edge available ho; subjective probabilities estimate karne ke liye robust fundamental research chahiye
data_needed: Historical price upside/downside distributions, target price estimates, fundamental win-loss probability ratios

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: CAP (Confidence-Adjusted Payoff) Portfolio Weight Allocation: Portfolio ke 15-20 selected stocks ko CAP score (CAP = Projected 3-5 Year Upside % x Confidence Factor 0..100%) ke आधार par descend karke weighting assign karo
entry: CAP ranking ke top stocks ko maximum weight (up to 10%) do
exit: Jab stock ka CAP rank bottom me gir jaye ya confidence factor deflated ho jaye
conditions: Single stock max allocation <= 10%, Min stock allocation >= 3%, Max company equity stake <= 5%, total portfolio size 15-20 stocks across non-correlated sectors
data_needed: 3-5 year projected stock upside %, company confidence rating, total portfolio capital

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: Focused Portfolio 15-20 Stock Optimal Risk-Diversification Rule: Maximum portfolio performance aur downside protection ke liye portfolio me exactly 15 se 20 non-correlated sector stocks rakho
entry: 15-20 high conviction QGLP stocks select karke enter karo
exit: Jab kisi stock ki thesis break ho to replacement stock se swap karo
conditions: 40+ stocks (over-diversification) avoid karo kyunki isse return benchmark ke barabar (modest) ho jata hai; < 10 stocks avoid karo high volatility ki wajah se
data_needed: Stock returns, stock correlation matrix, sector classification

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: Mini-to-Mid Market Cap Crossover Momentum Screen: Base Market Cap < Rs 2,000 Crore (Market Cap rank > 300) wale small cap stocks jinme high PAT CAGR (> 30%) aur high scalable niche ho, unhe Top 101-300 rank target ke liye buy karo
entry: Base Market Cap < Rs 2,000 Crore, Market Cap rank > 300, 5-yr PAT CAGR > 30%, P/E < 20x
exit: Market Cap rank 101-300 reach karne par ya 5 saal baad
stop: PAT growth 15% se neeche girne par exit
conditions: Scalable niche (e.g. air coolers, tiles, pharma) ya large sector me dominant player ho
data_needed: Market cap ranking, PAT CAGR 5-year, P/E ratio, industry market size

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: Mid-to-Mega Market Cap Crossover Strategy: Market Cap Rank 101 se 300 ke beech ke mid-cap stocks jinaka 5-year PAT CAGR > 20% aur RoE > 15% ho, unhe Top 100 Mega-cap rank migration ke liye buy karo
entry: Market Cap rank 101-300, 5-yr PAT CAGR > 20%, RoE > 15%
exit: Top 100 market cap category me enter hone ke baad target evaluation ya 5 saal holding
conditions: Mid-cap universe of 200 stocks se pick karo (historical baseline success rate 13%, average return 31% CAGR)
data_needed: Daily/Annual market cap rankings, historical 5-year PAT growth, RoE

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: Consumer Discretionary Brand Compounding Consistency Screen: 10-saal ke track record par Consumer Discretionary brand companies (Asian Paints, Titan, Dabur) ko buy-and-hold karo jinaka 10-year Price CAGR >= 20% aur PAT CAGR >= 15% ho
entry: Consumer facing discretionary brand + 10-yr PAT CAGR >= 15% + RoE >= 20%
exit: Brand equity loss ya structural growth slowdown
conditions: Secular demand tailwind; valuation (P/E) agnostic buy-and-hold strategy
data_needed: 10-year financial metrics, PAT CAGR, RoE history, sector categorization

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: Cyclical Commodities Earnings Peak Exit Rule: Metals, Mining, Oil & Gas, Capital Goods jaise cyclical sectors me earnings/commodity cycle ke peak par positions ko mandatory liquidate karo
market: sector / stocks (Metals, Mining, Oil & Gas, Capital Goods)
entry: Cyclical downturn ke bottom par jab earnings yield / valuation extreme low/distressed ho
exit: Commodity price peak / Peak earnings cycle par completely exit
stop: Earnings cycle reverse hote hi exit
conditions: Cyclicals me buy-and-hold long term ke liye mat karo; sell timing galat hone par 50-90% wealth destruction hota hai
data_needed: Global commodity prices, sector margins, quarterly PAT peak indicators

title: motilal_wcs_21_2011_16.txt
rule: Standalone Payback Ratio Valuation Screen: Buy stocks where Payback Ratio (Market Cap / Cumulative projected 5-year PAT) < 1.0x
entry: Payback ratio < 1.0x
exit: 5 saal baad ya Jab Payback ratio > 3.0x ho jaye
conditions: Cumulative 5-year projected PAT >= current market capitalization
data_needed: Market Cap, 5-year forward PAT projections
